summary: This is a routine Board of Directors meeting minutes filed by TIM S.A., a Brazilian telecommunications company, as a Form 6-K. The meeting includes acknowledgments of committee activities (Compensation, ESG, Control and Risks, Statutory Audit), approval of an internal policy update, recognition of Q1 2026 financial results subject to limited review by Ernst Young, approvals related to long-term incentive plan grants and payouts, and an update to the corporate calendar. No M&A, activist, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or other special-situation event is disclosed. The filing is purely operational and governance-related.
